name: Aulelia
source:
[spoiler]Aulelia was the daughter of the previous king (Season 1 timeline), and a princess of Gedonelune Kingdom. When she got pregnant before the marriage, her father, the late king flew into a rage and secretly ordered one of the royal family's attendant wizards, Conrad Schuyler, to take, hide the child in a neighbouring country and kill it. Not long after giving birth, Aulelia died from grief of being separated from her baby. Her baby survived as Schuyler was against the king's order. The only key to find Aulelia's kid was her earrings that before dying she left one with Schuyler, containing the kids' name Luciano Orudeus Gedonelune, Luca Orlem's full name, and another earring with Luca himself.

[From [url=https://wizardess-heart.fandom.com/wiki/Aulelia]Wizardess Heart Wiki[/url]][/spoiler]
